content: We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We need the sample's molecule. Not given directly. We have tools to get spectra: carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra. IR spectra can identify carbonyl stretch ~1700 cm-1. Could count peaks. Probably easiest: get IR spectra and count carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool.
